progress.summary: Impact selection now treats every manifest lesson source and reader subsystem path as one reader system, requiring build, conformance, architecture, and exact production closure. The reader build contains all seven declared pages, no undeclared pages, no compiler graph, and no dev-review graph.

expectedLearning: Whether Add manifest-aware impact and production-closure gates can be completed inside Reader composition-root convergence v0.
allowedWork: Reader compiler page shells, build-time route manifests, inferred URL codecs, browser lifecycle services, piecewise scroll clocks, frame scheduling, runtime lesson descriptors, production renderer adapters, derived conformance and review descriptors, impact selection, closure, and bundle budgets.
Compatibility changes required for both accepted readers to consume the shared contracts, provided exact visual, semantic, URL, static-searchability, and responsive parity remains proven.
disallowedWork: Do not alter accepted equation or distribution semantics, choreography, visual policy, typography, colors, layout, attention behavior, searchable prose, or route meaning.
Do not add branch scheduling, structured algebra, advanced fraction composition, LLM mutation, new subjects, WebGL generalization, or editor redesign.
Do not introduce an abstraction used only by tests or only one production reader; integrate it in both readers or defer it.
Do not edit unrelated user-authored roadmap, thread, decision, or design documents.
